name: Esther Jane Anthony (Allen)
notable_stories: After years of moving around the West and Midwest for George Philip's work during the Depression, the family settled in Pueblo, Colorado. She wanted a steadier life and was not happy with their modest means.
The preparer says she wanted a more stable life and was unhappy with the family's modest means; his mother recalled Esther railing at George Philip constantly while she lived with them after WWII.
milestones: Married George Philip Allen (m. 15 Jun 1919, First Baptist Church, Marceline, MO)
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams (compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen, Nov 2010)
Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: CORRECTION 2026-09-23: Dates, places, parents and children added from Bill Allen's family document. Mother of George Homer Allen and Margaret Jeanice "Peggy" Allen.
